purpose: Synthetic release-gate cases that must not be used for tuning.

cases.synthetic_prompt: Prepare a packing checklist for a fictional weekend rail trip.
cases.rationale: The exact low-risk leaf is visible in the flat baseline.

cases.synthetic_prompt: Review this fictional patch for correctness without deploying it.
cases.rationale: Deployment vocabulary must not override the explicit review intent.

cases.synthetic_prompt: Condense the fictional research memo into three findings.
cases.rationale: An eligible off-prompt leaf can be selected from the router-retrievable surface.

cases.synthetic_prompt: Describe the fictional deployment workflow; do not execute it.
cases.rationale: The denied mutating skill must be absent from the candidate set and top-k.

cases.synthetic_prompt: State the largest change in the sample table; no chart is needed.
cases.rationale: The routing evaluator asserts the table skill selection only and makes no claim about resource loading.

cases.synthetic_prompt: Draft a fictional meeting transcript with named speakers.
cases.rationale: A request outside the eligible routing surface must return no candidates.
